meta.name: Ek Rishtaa The Bond of Love
meta.description: A wealthy factory owner, played by  Amitabh Bachchan,  raises up his conniving son-in-law while breaking off with his own son, played by Akshay Kumar,  who then comes back to right all wrongs and save the family fortune.
meta.slogan: In times of happiness, they turned their backs to each other ... In testing times, they came back ....
